responsibility: Declares the command-line options accepted by the SPU backend and binds them to target masks or variables. It defines code-generation and tuning controls such as relocation diagnostics, DMA safety, branch hints and nop insertion, small/large memory models, fixed register ranges, architecture and tuning selection, effective-address model, address-space conversion, and software cache parameters, supplying the option table consumed by GCC’s option parser and later queried by spu.c and spu.h logic.
same_name_distinction: Defines the SPU-specific command-line options and their bindings to masks/variables such as memory model, DMA safety, hinting, and tuning controls. Unlike spu.c, spu.h, and spu.md, it does not implement backend behavior or describe instructions; it only declares the target’s user-visible options.
